description: Arrets d'autobus (RTCS) - Ville de Shawinigan is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Shawinigan. Couche ponctuelle des arrêts d'autobus de la régie de transport en commun de Shawinigan (RTCS) sur le territoire de la ville de Shawinigan. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Ville de Shawinigan. Its tags are Arret de bus, Autobus, Bus, Carte interactive, Donnee ouverte. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEOJSON, HTML. The portal shows 2026-07-27 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
